product: Dual-runtime factory. Strong control plane, dumb hands, cheap writer seats. Owner picks the writer from the ladder. Meter is DashScope PAYG. Path auto is native DeepSeek off-peak if healthy, DashScope on peak or outage.
mistake: Do not remap the control-plane session to DeepSeek, Qwen, or Cursor Cloud Agent. Do not give hands a model. Do not add a GitHub Action while the writer secret is missing. Do not buy Token Plan for F3.

controlPlane.note: The session the owner selects. AGENTS section 8. Generic by design: naming a vendor here dates the kit and every envelope stamped from it.
Grok chat. Fuse. Successor is AGENTS, BOARD, envelope.
Optional. Claude Code as judgment if the project manager already has it.

hands.note: Dumb runner. No model. No keys. factory/tools/hands.mjs.
Hands stay inside Claude Code. Do not remap that session onto a cheap model.

writerHarness.note: Qwen Code. Local Ollama or DashScope token. No Claude Code.
Git-native CLI. OpenAI-compat. No Claude Code. DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or DASHSCOPE_API_KEY in env.
Any OpenAI-compat client pointed at DeepSeek. No Claude Code. Token in env.
Claude Code harness with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL remapped. Writer seat only.
Local Cursor Chat/Agent may BYOK DeepSeek/Qwen. Cursor Cloud Agents, background, automations, and CLI cannot. Do not install Cursor to emulate the factory.

writerModel.note: Local Ollama tag. Not a DashScope API id. Hosted PAYG uses qwen3-coder-plus.
Native sweep (api.deepseek.com). Hosted DashScope id is deepseek-v4.1-flash.
Native keystone. Hosted snapshot is deepseek-v4-pro-0813. Unversioned DashScope deepseek-v4-pro is the $2.40/$4.80 alias.
DashScope Singapore sweep. Same meter as Qwen. Do not send native id deepseek-flash to DashScope.
DashScope Singapore keystone snapshot. Peak/off-peak. Do not send unversioned deepseek-v4-pro.
Qwen flagship. Keystone only when named.
Strong general sweep on DashScope PAYG.
Floor that is still acceptable. Cheap PAYG sweep.

isolate.note: git worktree from live main on the machine that runs hands.
Generic VPS/Fly clone print. Prefer git-bus or codespace.
Cloud CP writes the envelope blob. The PC that already autobuilds fetches and isolates. No new machine.
Throwaway GitHub Codespace. Writer token is a Codespaces secret, not git, not an Action. Printed gh create; not a red workflow.
Sibling clone of factory/help.json target. Not a second remote on this repo. Envelope holds are product paths.

land.note: git merge --ff-only after APPROVED. Local hands.
PR rebase after VERDICT: APPROVED. Printed, not a red Action.

envelopeStore.note: factory/envelopes/<lane>.md. Deleted on land. Issues are not the board.

access.note: Only the GitHub owner produces landed commits. Children return intakes. Parent default. Collaborator invite is not this pick.
Anyone with read forks and opens a PR. Merge credits them as a GitHub contributor. They never receive write. They never push main.
Invite write. Topic branches. Owner still lands main. Write access is not a contributor; a landed commit is.

commitCredit.note: Author email is on the owner's GitHub account. Else the commit is anonymous on Insights and the contribution graph.
login@users.noreply.github.com (or id+login@). Counts if that noreply address is on the account.
Seat may author. Message includes Co-authored-by: Name <email on the owner account>. Factory email grok@factory is a miss.

promptCache.note: Native API prefix cache (DeepSeek disk, Grok automatic, Qwen implicit). Stable prefix first. Paste prompt_cache_hit_tokens or cached_tokens.
Claude or Qwen cache_control markers. Use when the harness can set them. Same prefix law.
Ollama / vLLM / llama.cpp prefix KV cache on the autobuild PC. Free. Same prefix law. No bill line.
Do not rely on cache. Still keep the prefix stable so a later pick can turn it on.

helpMode.note: This repo is the product. Parent default.
Sidecar factory. Fork the target. PR product files only. Never land target main. Never put factory/ in that PR.
Invited write on the target. Topic branches. Factory files stay in this repo. Target owner still lands main.
Copy the kit into the product. Alumni (Otto, Virbos) refuse this without a quiet week, kit SHA pin, and owner word. Not a GitHub fork of Grok.

writerMeter.note: Alibaba Model Studio Singapore. Standard key. Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM. Not Token Plan.
api.deepseek.com. Cheaper off-peak. Pair with dashscope-payg for auto.

writerPath.note: Native DeepSeek off-peak if healthy. DashScope PAYG on peak, timeout, or Qwen.
Pin api.deepseek.com. Owner accepts peak rates. Outage still fails over.

routing.hands: hands.mjs; Claude Code only if the PM picked it
routing.reviewer: never weaker than the writer, never the writer
routing.isolate: git-bus if the autobuild PC is on; codespace if it is not
routing.promptCache: Native to the model API or local runtime. Factory orchestrates prefix stability. Do not build an answer cache.
routing.tokenOnly: Claude Code absent. Grok judges. Writer is aider+DeepSeek or qwen-code+DashScope. PC: pc-token / pc-dashscope. Cloud: cloud-grok / cloud-dashscope.
routing.help: Sidecar factory helps an ongoing product. Copy the kit into an empty remote. Name the target in factory/help.json. Do not overlay alumni. Do not land the target's main. Do not run one sitting as CP of Grok and Virbos.
routing.writerPath: Owner picks the model. auto: native DeepSeek off-peak if healthy; DashScope PAYG on peak or outage. Qwen is always DashScope. Pin native or dashscope to override.
routing.writerMeter: dashscope-payg is the unified Alibaba meter. Token Plan is not this pick.

ratesUsdPerM.note: Indicative September 2026. Derive from the vendor page before you spend. inCached is a cache hit, not a miss.
